main_text.head: AD AUTHOREM
Epigramma Johannis Piscatoris.
main_text.p: QUis non collaudet tres hos, Aslache, libellos: De triplici calo quos tua dextra dedit?
E calo aereo vitalem ducimus auram: Dignum ergo nobis cognitione venit.
Calo in stelligero delectant sidera visum: Dignum ergo nobis cognitione venit.
Calo in perpetuo sunt gaudia summa reposita: Dignum ergo nobis cognitione venit.
De tribus his calis tu docte disseris. Ergo Collaudent cuncti qua tua dextra dedit.

page.notes: Show-through from the reverse page and stains lie across the lower half of the page; they are not transcribed. The verse lines are set in italic with a large initial Q. The line-final marks after "venit" and "dedit" are printed tails, transcribed as printed. Some words in the first stanza's second line ("De triplici") are set in roman and italic mixed; read as printed.
